```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(skimr)

dat_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    n_authors = as.numeric(n_authors),
    n_countries = as.numeric(n_countries),
    is_hyperauthored = n_authors >= 100,
    collaboration_mode = case_when(
      is_hyperauthored ~ "Hyperauthored",
      n_countries == 2 ~ "Strict Bilateral",
      n_countries > 2 ~ "Multilateral",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other")),
    quartile = as.character(quartile),
    quartile = if_else(is.na(quartile), "Unknown", quartile),
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Unknown")),
    fund = factor(fund, labels = c("Unfunded", "Funded")),
    OA = factor(OA, labels = c("Closed", "Open Access"))
  )

data_core <- dat_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |>
  droplevels()
```


```{r}
dat_reg |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  summarise(
    Papers = n(),
    Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", n() / nrow(dat_reg) * 100),
    `Mean Authors` = mean(n_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mean Countries` = mean(n_countries, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mean Citations` = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Median Citations` = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.1: Structural Characteristics by Collaboration Mode") 
```


```{r}
subject_cols <- c("agr_bio", "art_hum", "bio_chem", "buss", "chem_eng", 
                  "chem", "comp_sci", "earth", "econ", "ener", "egin", 
                  "env_sci", "immu", "mat_sci", "math", "med", "neuro", 
                  "nurse", "pharm", "phys", "psy", "soc_sci", "vet")

mode_totals <- data_core |> count(collaboration_mode)

data_core |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, all_of(subject_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -collaboration_mode, names_to = "Subject", values_to = "Present") |>
  filter(Present == 1) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, Subject) |>
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(mode_totals, by = "collaboration_mode") |>
  mutate(Percentage = sprintf("%.1f%%", Count / n * 100)) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  slice_max(order_by = Count, n = 5) |> 
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, Subject, Count, Percentage) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.3: Top 5 Disciplines by Collaboration Mode (Total N matches Mode Size)") 
```


```{r}
data_core |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, quartile, OA) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(quartile, OA), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Category") |>
  count(collaboration_mode, Metric, Category) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, Metric) |>
  mutate(
    Total_in_Mode = sum(n),
    Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", n / Total_in_Mode * 100)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = collaboration_mode, values_from = c(n, Share)) |>
  arrange(Metric, Category) |>
  dplyr::select(Metric, Category, 
                `n_Strict Bilateral`, `Share_Strict Bilateral`, 
                n_Multilateral, Share_Multilateral) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.4: Journal Quartile and Open Access Distribution (Includes Unknowns)") 
```


```{r}
data_core |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  summarise(
    `Total Papers` = n(),
    `Any Funding` = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(fund == "Funded") * 100),

    `Vietnam Funded (All)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(vn == 1) * 100),

    `US Funded` = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(us == 1) * 100),

  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.5: Funding Sources by Collaboration Mode") 
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table 1.2: Annual Volume (Corrected)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. Calculate yearly counts
t1_2_data <- data_core |>
  count(year, collaboration_mode) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = collaboration_mode, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    Total = `Strict Bilateral` + Multilateral,
    `% Bilateral` = sprintf("%.1f%%", `Strict Bilateral` / Total * 100)
  )

# 2. Calculate totals row
t1_2_total <- t1_2_data |>
  summarise(
    year = "Total", 
    `Strict Bilateral` = sum(`Strict Bilateral`), 
    Multilateral = sum(Multilateral),
    Total = sum(Total),
    `% Bilateral` = sprintf("%.1f%%", sum(`Strict Bilateral`) / sum(Total) * 100)
  ) 

# 3. Bind and Display (Fixing the type mismatch here)
t1_2_data |>
  arrange(desc(year)) |>
  mutate(year = as.character(year)) |> # Convert to character to match "Total"
  bind_rows(t1_2_total) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.2: Annual Volume of Core Collaboration Modes") 


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table 1.6: Citation Distribution Tiers (Impact Depth)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_core |>
  mutate(
    Citation_Tier = case_when(
      cited == 0 ~ "Zero (0)",
      cited >= 1 & cited <= 10 ~ "Low (1-10)",
      cited >= 11 & cited <= 50 ~ "Medium (11-50)",
      cited >= 51 & cited <= 100 ~ "High (51-100)",
      cited > 100 ~ "Very High (>100)"
    ),
    Citation_Tier = factor(Citation_Tier, 
                           levels = c("Zero (0)", "Low (1-10)", "Medium (11-50)", "High (51-100)", "Very High (>100)"))
  ) |>
  count(collaboration_mode, Citation_Tier) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  mutate(Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", n / sum(n) * 100)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = collaboration_mode, values_from = c(n, Share)) |>
  dplyr::select(Citation_Tier, 
                `n_Strict Bilateral`, `Share_Strict Bilateral`, 
                n_Multilateral, Share_Multilateral) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.6: Distribution of Citation Impact Tiers") 


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table 1.7: Macro-Area Composition
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_core |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, LS, PS, HS, SS) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(LS, PS, HS, SS), names_to = "Macro_Area", values_to = "Present") |>
  filter(Present == 1) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, Macro_Area) |>
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  mutate(
    Total_Papers = if_else(collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral", 
                           nrow(filter(data_core, collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral")),
                           nrow(filter(data_core, collaboration_mode == "Multilateral"))),
    Percentage = sprintf("%.1f%%", Count / Total_Papers * 100)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, Macro_Area, Count, Percentage) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = collaboration_mode, values_from = c(Count, Percentage)) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 1.7: Macro-Area Composition (Life, Physical, Health, Social Sciences)") 
```

```{r}
# T-test for Authorship Proportion
t_test_prop <- t.test(prop_vn_authors ~ collaboration_mode, data = data_core)

# Chi-square for Leadership (VN vs JP only, to enable direct comparison)
leadership_table <- table(data_core$collaboration_mode, data_core$vn_led)
chisq_led <- chisq.test(leadership_table)

# Chi-square for Balance Types
balance_table <- table(data_core$collaboration_mode, data_core$collab_type)
chisq_bal <- chisq.test(balance_table)

tibble(
  Metric = c("Authorship Proportion (Mean)", "VN Leadership Rate", "Balance Category Distribution"),
  Test = c("Welch Two Sample t-test", "Pearson's Chi-squared", "Pearson's Chi-squared"),
  Statistic = c(sprintf("t = %.2f", t_test_prop$statistic), 
                sprintf("X2 = %.2f", chisq_led$statistic), 
                sprintf("X2 = %.2f", chisq_bal$statistic)),
  P_Value = c(sprintf("%.3e", t_test_prop$p.value), 
              sprintf("%.3e", chisq_led$p.value), 
              sprintf("%.3e", chisq_bal$p.value)),
  Result = c("Significant difference", "Significant difference", "Significant difference")
) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 2.5: Statistical Comparison of Equity Between Modes") 
```

# R3


```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(MASS)
library(modelsummary)
library(margins)

dat_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    n_authors = as.numeric(n_authors),
    n_countries = as.numeric(n_countries),
    is_hyperauthored = n_authors >= 100,
    collaboration_mode = case_when(
      is_hyperauthored ~ "Hyperauthored",
      n_countries == 2 ~ "Strict Bilateral",
      n_countries > 2 ~ "Multilateral",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other")),
    quartile = as.character(quartile),
    quartile = if_else(is.na(quartile) | quartile == "Unknown", "Non-Q1", quartile),
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Non-Q1")),
    fund = factor(fund, labels = c("Unfunded", "Funded")),
    OA = factor(OA, labels = c("Closed", "Open Access"))
  )

# Core Corpus for Analysis
data_core <- dat_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |>
  mutate(
    year_centered = year - 2000,
    prop_vn_centered = prop_vn_authors - mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Reference level for Leadership: Other-led (for Multilateral) or JP-led (for Bilateral comparison)
    # Here we stick to the regression dummy approach: vn_led and jp_led included, Intercept is Other-led
    is_Q1 = if_else(quartile == "Q1", 1, 0)
  )
```


```{r}
data_core |>
  mutate(Leadership = case_when(
    vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
    jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
    TRUE ~ "Other-led"
  )) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, Leadership) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_Citations = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Citations = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_Citations = IQR(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(collaboration_mode, desc(Mean_Citations)) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 3.1: Citation Impact by Leadership and Collaboration Mode") 
```


```{r}
data_core |>
  mutate(Funding_Type = case_when(
    bilateral_funding == 1 ~ "Bilateral Co-funded",
    jap == 1 & vn == 0 ~ "Japan Only",
    vn == 1 & jap == 0 ~ "Vietnam Only",
    fund == "Funded" ~ "Other Funding",
    TRUE ~ "Unfunded"
  )) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, Funding_Type) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_Citations = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Citations = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(collaboration_mode, desc(Mean_Citations)) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 3.2: Citation Impact by Funding Configuration") 
```


```{r}
# Model 1: Baseline
m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led + jp_led + year_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
             data = data_core)

# Model 2: Structure
m2 <- update(m1, . ~ . + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered)

# Model 3: Resources
# Note: Using is_Q1 binary to simplify interaction interpretation later
m3 <- update(m2, . ~ . + fund + is_Q1 + OA)

# Model 4: Interactions (Testing the Parity Hypothesis)
m4 <- update(m3, . ~ . + vn_led:fund + vn_led:is_Q1 + vn_led:year_centered)

# Create Regression Table
modelsummary(
  list(
    "M1: Baseline" = m1, 
    "M2: Structure" = m2, 
    "M3: Resources" = m3, 
    "M4: Interactions" = m4
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE, # Report Incidence Rate Ratios (IRR)
  gof_map = c("nobs", "aic", "bic"),
  coef_map = c(
    "vn_led" = "VN-led",
    "jp_led" = "JP-led",
    "collaboration_modeMultilateral" = "Multilateral Mode",
    "prop_vn_centered" = "Prop VN Authors (Centered)",
    "fundFunded" = "Funded",
    "is_Q1" = "Q1 Journal",
    "OAOpen Access" = "Open Access",
    "vn_led:fundFunded" = "VN-led × Funded",
    "vn_led:is_Q1" = "VN-led × Q1",
    "vn_led:year_centered" = "VN-led × Year"
  ),
  title = "Table 3.3: Negative Binomial Regression Predicting Citations (IRR)"
)
```


```{r}
# Create hypothetical scenarios
scenarios <- data_core |>
  dplyr::select(year_centered, LS, PS, HS, SS, collaboration_mode, prop_vn_centered, OA, is_Q1, fund, vn_led, jp_led) |>
  # Fix control variables at mode/mean
  mutate(
    year_centered = max(year_centered), # Current year (2024)
    LS = 0, PS = 1, HS = 0, SS = 0,     # Physical Sciences baseline
    collaboration_mode = "Strict Bilateral",
    prop_vn_centered = 0,
    OA = "Closed"
  ) |>
  slice(1:4) # Just need 4 rows to overwrite

# Define scenarios
scenarios$Scenario <- c("VN-led (Baseline)", "JP-led (Baseline)", "VN-led (Optimal)", "JP-led (Optimal)")
scenarios$vn_led <- c(1, 0, 1, 0)
scenarios$jp_led <- c(0, 1, 0, 1)
scenarios$fund   <- c("Unfunded", "Unfunded", "Funded", "Funded")
scenarios$is_Q1  <- c(0, 0, 1, 1)

# Predict
scenarios$Predicted_Citations <- predict(m4, newdata = scenarios, type = "response")

scenarios |>
  dplyr::select(Scenario, fund, is_Q1, Predicted_Citations) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 3.4: Predicted Impact Scenarios (Model 4 Estimates)") 
```

# Robustness


```{r}
# R1: Log-OLS
m_ols <- lm(log(cited + 1) ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
            jp_led + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
            data = data_core)

# R2: Strict Bilateral Subset (Negative Binomial)
data_bilateral <- data_core |> filter(collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral")
m_bilateral <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
                      jp_led + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
                      data = data_bilateral)

# R3: Recent Period Only (2015-2024)
data_recent <- data_core |> filter(year >= 2015)
m_recent <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
                   jp_led + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
                   data = data_recent)

# Comparison Table
modelsummary(
  list(
    "Main Model (M4)" = glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
                               jp_led + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
                               data = data_core),
    "R1: Log-OLS" = m_ols,
    "R2: Bilateral Only" = m_bilateral,
    "R3: Recent (2015+)" = m_recent
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r2", "aic"),
  coef_map = c(
    "vn_led" = "VN-led",
    "fundFunded" = "Funded", 
    "is_Q1" = "Q1 Journal",
    "vn_led:fundFunded" = "VN-led × Funded",
    "vn_led:is_Q1" = "VN-led × Q1"
  ),
  title = "Table 5.1: Robustness Checks for Impact Parity"
)
```


```{r}
# Re-run main model M4
main_model <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
                     jp_led + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
                     data = data_core)

# Calculate Cook's Distance
cooks_d <- cooks.distance(main_model)
influential_threshold <- 4 / nrow(data_core)
n_influential <- sum(cooks_d > influential_threshold)

# Descriptive check
tibble(
  Metric = "Influential Observations (Cook's D)",
  Count = n_influential,
  Share = sprintf("%.2f%%", n_influential / nrow(data_core) * 100),
  Threshold = sprintf("%.4f", influential_threshold)
) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 5.2: Influential Outlier Check") 
```


```{r}
# Filter out influential cases
data_robust <- data_core[cooks_d <= influential_threshold, ]

m_no_outliers <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
                        jp_led + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
                        data = data_robust)

modelsummary(
  list(
    "Original M4" = main_model,
    "No Outliers" = m_no_outliers
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  coef_map = c("vn_led", "vn_led:fundFunded", "vn_led:is_Q1"),
  title = "Table 5.3: Sensitivity Analysis (Removing Influential Cases)"
)
```

```{r}
# Re-estimate Model 4 (Required for ggeffects)
library(MASS)
m4 <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led * fund + vn_led * is_Q1 + vn_led * year_centered + 
             jp_led + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
             data = data_core)

# Calculate Marginal Effects
pred_fund <- ggpredict(m4, terms = c("fund", "vn_led")) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(group == "1", "VN-led", "Other/JP-led"))

# Plot
p2 <- ggplot(pred_fund, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other/JP-led" = "grey60", "VN-led" = "#2E86C1")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Citations by Funding & Leadership",
    subtitle = "VN-led papers gain significantly more from funding",
    y = "Predicted Citations",
    x = "Funding Status",
    color = "Leadership"
  )

p2

  count(Subject, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Share = n / 274) |> # 274 is total hyper papers
  head(5) |>
  kable(caption = "Top 5 Disciplines in Hyperauthored Papers (>100 Authors)") 
```
